name: Disgaea Mayhem
storyline:
This is the vast Netherworld, where countless demons vie for supremacy.

In one of these many Netherworlds, a veteran mercenary named Nueur is summoned by the Superlative Netherworld overlord Tisiel, who has a shocking request.

“Someone ate the pudding from the refrigerator!”

“I see… wait, the what from the refrigerator?”

The pudding in question is the First Radiance Pudding, created by Tisiel’s now-deceased father, the former Superlative Overlord. It was eaten by a subordinate who staged a rebellion, and Tisiel wants it back.

Thus begins the battle to reclaim the First Radiance Pudding, led by a lone mercenary and a fledgling overlord…!
summary:
Disgaea Mayhem is a brand-new 3D action RPG from an all-star team consisting of director Shunsuke Minowa, character designer Takehito Harada, and composer Tenpei Sato.

In this game, players will be able to experience the exhilaration of defeating enemies with overwhelming power that defies convention—unleashing flashy techniques with simple controls, completionist elements like leveling characters up to 9,999 and “reincarnating” them to grow even stronger, and developing overpowered stats that let them deal over a billion damage.
